title: Backyard Green A-Z
hook: A whole little world is waiting just outside.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: two short beats for mixed-age retrieval
visualStyle: cozy 3D backyard garden storybook, sunny fence and lawn, colorful planters, simple child-safe scene, crisp foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child taking one slow loop from the back door around a small backyard garden and back again
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: zoom out briefly from close-up discoveries and remind the listener that the whole adventure is just outside
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: easygoing 4/4 backyard walk with occasional half-time close-ups
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written spatial walk; use under/beside/near/behind/along and child-height viewpoints, with varied line lengths and sparse rhyme so the backyard feels observed rather than catalogued
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: location cue -> two-beat recall space -> target -> small look/trace/shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make an ordinary backyard feel enormous at child scale: one step outside reveals tiny worlds under leaves, beside pots, along a fence and close to the soil.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child narrator moves physically through a familiar backyard using near/beside/under/around language and close-up discoveries; wonder comes from proximity, not fantasy.
imageMotifs: late light near the back door
semanticArc: move from path and hose into beds and pots
kneel closer for tiny flowers, seed and worm
stand up and return to the door seeing the same yard differently
forbiddenGenericLanguage: look and point along with me
